entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help. I'm just so disappointed. I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I feel awful about it.

I'm certainly sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just a preference, it wasn't what I expected. But the real problem is... I tried to return it ages ago, right after Christmas, and your website was broken. I really needed this money back, and now I'm worried I'm too late. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for so long, this is the first time I've had an issue.
I understand your concern, and I want to help sort this out. You mentioned a problem with the site. Can you describe what happened when you tried to process the return?

It was a total website error. I'd click the return button, and the whole page would just go blank. The whole system must have been down. I tried for almost an hour because I really needed to get it sent back, but I couldn't print the label. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I was so worried this would happen.

Thank you for that detail, that's very helpful. Let me just check our system logs for that timeframe... Yes, I do see a notification about a known site-wide outage on December 24th. I am so sorry you were impacted by that. Let me pull up your order details.
Okay... I just hope it's not too late.
Alright, I see your order. It was delivered 23 days ago. Let's see... our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. So, you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? Really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so stressed about this. Thank you so much, Diana.

Of course. And given that you tried to return it earlier and were prevented by that system down issue, I'm more than happy to get this processed for you right away. I'm sending you a prepaid return label to your email on file now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
You're a lifesaver. Thank you, I really appreciate you understanding.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
